uncertain.note: the page carries two notes keyed b: the Horace note at the head (last letter of the previous annotation's run) and the first-run-restart note under ANNOT. XIX. (a b c d). The second is keyed b2 per §4's a2/a3 rule so the keys stay unique; the print shows a plain b in both body and margin. Reader A may have keyed them differently.
the final u carries a heavy mark above it; read as plain 'au' (sense requires it), but it could be a damaged sort or a tilde (aũ).
a stroke sits over the final e of 'Ode'; read as plain e, but it may be an acute (Odé) or ink offset.
the roman numerals are very small and partly blotted at native resolution; iij could be ij and viij could be vij.
printed 'l. fin .C. de' with the point set before the C; spacing normalized per §1.
last word read 'illec'; the canonical citation would be 'illic' and the letter before the final c is ambiguous.

uncertain.note: a faint speck sits over the first e of 'intention'; read as plain e (unlike the solid tilde of 'cõſort'), but a tilde (intẽtion) cannot be excluded.

uncertain.note: the mark after marker a is a compact square dot on the baseline, read as a period; it matches the marks after markers b2 and d on this page.
